method: Accelerated COMPLETE production frame, explicit dt .25 s, normal input vector, real controllers/collisions/streaming/audio/rig. Rendering only at checkpoints; not a native film or FPS test. Diagnostic source-road placement only BEFORE traversal except spawn which is untouched. No position assignment or collider alteration during travel.
